mairie.importantText: The civil wedding must legally take place before any religious ceremony. Documents and deadlines may vary between city halls — always check your local city hall's official website.
mairie.conditionsNote: Note: In exceptional cases, a dispensation for family ties may be granted by the President of the Republic.
conditions: Marriage allowed between same-sex or different-sex couples (law of 17 May 2013)

etapes.title: Prepare the file
etapes.description: Gather all required documents. Check on your city hall's official website as requirements may vary.

etapes.title: Book an appointment
etapes.description: Contact the city hall 2-3 months before the desired date to schedule a filing appointment.

etapes.title: File submission meeting
etapes.description: Attend with your complete file. The civil registrar may request a joint hearing of the future spouses.

etapes.title: Banns publication
etapes.description: Mandatory display for 10 days at the city hall. Deadlines vary depending on your situation (4 to 8 weeks).

etapes.title: Civil ceremony
etapes.description: Official celebration by the civil registrar in the presence of your witnesses. Duration: about 20-30 minutes.

faq.q: How do I use the custom checklist?
faq.a: Go to 'Custom checklist' and describe your situation to generate a task list tailored to your wedding.

faq.q: What's the difference between the basic and custom checklist?
faq.a: The basic checklist contains essential universal tasks, while the custom one adapts to your specifics (venue, number of guests, style, etc.).

faq.q: How do I start organizing my wedding?
faq.a: Start with the style quiz to define your preferences, then use the budget calculator to estimate your costs.

faq.q: Can I share my planning with my vendors?
faq.a: Yes! Use the 'Share' button to create a read-only link you can send to your vendors and family.

faq.q: How do I use Wedding Mission?
faq.a: Wedding Mission lets you create tasks, assign them to your team and track the progress of your preparation.

faq.q: What should I do after my wedding?
faq.a: Check the 'After the big day' section for tips on the next-day brunch, cleanup, equipment returns and thank-yous.
Yes, all your data is automatically saved in your secure personal space.
